subject.title: [Feature] Configurable thinking/reasoning block format per channel

question: Should OpenClaw add a public reasoning display-format contract, and if so should precedence be per-channel, per-agent, or both?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the fix adds public configuration and cross-channel behavior where repository policy requires maintainer intent rather than an automatic bug-fix patch.

options.title: Add a minimal display-format contract
options.body: Preserve italic by default, support a small enum such as italic/code/spoiler or blockquote, and document one precedence order across channel and agent defaults.

options.title: Limit this to Telegram rich formatting
options.body: Defer a shared agent config and resolve Telegram readability through the channel formatting/parse-mode direction tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/10944.

options.title: Reject new config surface for now
options.body: Keep the fixed italic rendering and ask users to use reasoning visibility controls until a broader reasoning presentation design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Add a minimal display-format contract
recommendation.body: Preserve italic by default, support a small enum such as italic/code/spoiler or blockquote, and document one precedence order across channel and agent defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: The history and prior issue comment both point to steipete as the best available owner for the reasoning-display API decision.
